summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 7 million of its ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International on July 20, 2026, at a volume-weighted average price of 111.4748 pence per share. The purchases are part of an existing share buyback program announced January 30, 2026, and the shares will be cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an issuer share repurchase under a previously authorized program, returning capital to shareholders. There is no premium, tender offer, or structural complexity. As a routine buyback announcement under a standing program, it constitutes a capital return event.
